title: SciField — 78-journal literature cartography of surgery (V2 cartography release)
description: SciField is a framework for monitoring and mapping the health and movement of a scientific field. This V2 cartography release maps the surgical literature across a 78-journal panel built on a 1.49M-paper corpus (V2-S08 harvest). It ships the scaled cartography layers (V2-S09): a topic landscape (149 leaf topics over a leaf→mid→top hierarchy), journal-to-journal cascade lead–lag diffusion, source / bridge / terminal journal roles, and novelty origins by institution sector and country; plus a descriptive per-topic trajectory layer (V2-S10) projecting share and volume +5 years to 2030 with 80% uncertainty bands (descriptive extrapolation, not a forecast); plus an interactive static 5-tab map. The exploratory-cartography track passed Gate G6 (2026-06-09). The deposit redistributes the derived cartography tables (~1.7 MB) and the static map; the raw 1.49M-paper corpus is not redistributed but is reproducible from the pipeline in the repository. See docs/cartography/data-dictionary.md for the table-by-table data dictionary and the panel-conditional / 1995-left-censored / descriptive-projection caveats.
